C0.quote: A deterministic voting rule, or a voting rule for short, is a mapping
C0.note: Binary voting rules aggregating individuals' choices into a collective decision.

C1.quote: a deterministic voting rule is robust if and only if it is a WMR
C1.note: Main results characterise rules satisfying robustness. WD covers the Pareto efficiency/responsiveness results (Sect. 5, App. D). SB covers the online appendix strategyproofness result (Lemma B).

C2.1.quote: The choices of the group members are summarized by a decision profile

C2.2.quote: individuals report their ordinal ranking of two alternatives
C2.2.note: Inputs are binary choices in {-1,1}, which the paper describes as an ordinal ranking of two alternatives. OTH would also fit; RANK is listed first.

C2.3.quote: Individual 𝑖 ∈ 𝑁 has a VNM utility function
C2.3.note: Preferences and VNM utilities are attributed to individuals.

C2.4.quote: a voting mechanism, where individuals can vote insincerely
C2.4.note: Utilities u_i and votes sigma_i(u_i) have separate notation. The main text assumes sincerity and justifies it.

C3.1.quote: the sincere voting strategy 𝛿𝑖 is a best response to any strategy
C3.1.note: Main-text analyses assume sincere voting; the online appendix considers voting strategies.

C3.2.quote: An individual is assumed to vote sincerely

C3.3.quote: a sincere voting strategy is weakly dominant under a robust rule

C4.1.loc: Sect. 1, p. 2; Online Appendix B, p. 3
C4.1.quote: the utility from the passage of a favorable issue is one
C4.1.note: The online appendix defines the preferred alternative from u_i, and responsiveness as expected utility with 0/1 utilities.

C4.2.note: The term 'dichotomous preferences' is not used; 'dichotomous setting' refers to two alternatives.

C5.1.quote: strict efficiency is equivalent to robustness as a requirement for voting rules
C5.1.note: Pareto efficiency in terms of responsiveness.

C5.2.quote: An individual is assumed to vote sincerely and prefer a voting rule
C5.2.note: Responsiveness is computed on decision profiles. The online appendix also evaluates on held utilities.

VOT.loc_behav: Sect. 3, p. 8; Online Appendix A, p. 1
VOT.quote_behav: An individual is assumed to vote sincerely
VOT.note: Sincere in the main text; strategies analysed in the online appendix via weak dominance, with no information assumption about others.
